summary: Sprint #4 MASCI Operations Center / Live Map — backend + frontend verified end-to-end. All 7 visible UI/UX fixes confirmed against preview. Backend pytest 12 passed / 1 skipped (geofence-fallback skip is environmental). Frontend layout, banner labels, project intelligence visual hierarchy, severity wedges, overflow language, asset sheet section order, and Data Source trust chip all match spec. Banned-vocab DOM scan returns ZERO hits inside [data-testid='operations-map-page'] and inside the asset sheet (no 'Buckets', 'Reporting', 'Needs Attention', 'Telemetry Poll', 'motive:poll', etc.). Performance excellent (warm snapshot 347ms). One BORDERLINE layout finding at 1920x800: map height = 364px / vp 800 = 0.455 (spec asks >=0.50). At 1080p+ viewports this is healthy (>0.60). Recommend trimming ~16px from project strip or banner to hit the 50% floor at 800h.

issues: Map canvas height ratio is 0.455 (canvas=364px, viewport=800px); spec requires >=0.50. Fixed grid rows (56+80+168+132=436px chrome) consume more than 50% at 800px viewport. At 1080p the ratio rises to ~0.60 and meets spec. Suggest reducing project strip from 168px -> 152px OR banner from 80px -> 72px to keep map >=50% at 800h.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: At 1920x800 viewport, map canvas height ratio is 0.455 (<0.50 spec). Reduce one chrome row (recommend ops-map-projects 168px -> 152px or banner 80px -> 72px) so map stays >=50% on shorter viewports. Higher viewports already pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ProjectIntelligenceStrip severity wedge logic correctly biases worst card first (tone-rose when attention>0); 5 visible cards all tone-rose in preview which is faithful to data (every top area has attention>0).
AssetCardSheet section order in JSX matches spec; data-testid coverage complete (identity, assignment, health, operator, open-issues, position, events, trust).
MapTrustChip uses describeFeed() -> 'Live/Delayed/Offline Feed' + Low/Medium/High Confidence; never leaks raw 'motive:poll' or 'LOW' uppercase codes — clean.
Backend snapshot caps project_rollups to 5 with project_rollups_overflow + project_rollups_total accompanying — overflow pill renders '+N more areas' as expected (areas, NOT buckets).
Grid template '56px 80px 168px 1fr 132px' totals 436px of fixed chrome — borderline at 800px viewport for the >=50% map requirement. Recommend tightening one row by 12-16px.
